items.title: Eddie Dawson Interview, 1961-06-28
items.q: Like Bob Burns used to use on radio.

ctx.x: Well you know Rene had taken Simon too. Yeah. Simon Moreira. When you had a Bitskin band came in. Huh? When you had a Bitskin band came in. What band? Bitskin. Yeah. You know a Zuta band you call it. Oh you're talking about uh. You're talking about uh.
Something called bazooka sometimes too. Like Bob Burns used to use on radio. That's fun of me. Slowgraf played in one of those.
Yeah. They had a big old bread rod there. That's nice. Yeah it's all in the end of it. Yeah he's playing the bass. That's uh. stuff with stuff
